look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson fifteen
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 4, lesson T15, 1m / 5m / 15m Timeframes; fifteen small candles fold into three and then one; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Same market, three views
scenes.desc: A fictional 15-minute BTC chart; a 1m / 5m / 15m switch turns fifteen candles into three and then one; the market did not change.

scenes.name: What a timeframe is
scenes.desc: Timeframe defined: the time each candle covers; fifteen 1-minute cells group into 5-minute and 15-minute blocks; diary analogy (days, weeks, a month).

scenes.name: Build a 5-minute candle
scenes.desc: Five 1-minute candles and their OHLC table: open = first open 60,000, high = highest high 60,110, low = lowest low 59,980, close = last close 60,090; they merge into one green 5-minute candle.

scenes.name: Build a 15-minute candle
scenes.desc: All fifteen minutes give open 60,000, high 60,170, low 59,920, close 60,150; the three 5-minute candles give the same result.

scenes.name: One path, three views
scenes.desc: One fictional price path on a 10:00 to 10:15 axis; 1m, 5m and 15m candles are drawn over the same path; the path never moves.

scenes.name: Noise and signal
scenes.desc: Noise defined: the 1-minute drop from 10:05 looks big; on the 15-minute view it is a dip inside one green candle; signal defined, still no promise.

scenes.name: Higher-timeframe context
scenes.desc: Context defined: check the bigger view first; map zoom analogy; 15m, 5m and 1m panels; disagreement is a reason for care or WAIT.

scenes.name: No averages
scenes.desc: Common mistake: averaging highs gives 60,060; the 5-minute high is the highest high, 60,120.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and combine five 1-minute candles (10:10 to 10:14): open 60,010, high 60,170, low 59,990, close 60,150.

scenes.name: View or market?
scenes.desc: Four statements are sorted: switching timeframe and wider candles are the view; a trade and a price move are the market.

scenes.name: Know the limits
scenes.desc: Short timeframes are noisy, more candles are not more chances, frequent trading adds fees, no timeframe predicts; WAIT and NO_TRADE are allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one question: the 5-minute close is the last 1-minute close, 60,090.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T16, Trend and Market Structure.
